archetypes.name: design-finalize-flow
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 sentinel and publish ordering are easy to regress when sanitizer moves across the Python/prompt boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for /design Step 5 ordering and sentinel correctness. Focus on Step 5b.5 sanitize folding, Step 5c publish-tail rc handling, and OOS NEXT_ACTION fail-closed behavior. Flag any path where publish can run before Step 5b is complete, where sanitizer warnings leak diagram content, or where legacy fallback removal changes live routing. Cite the plan section and concrete repository paths in every finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
